newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Three killed in Portugal motorway pile-up.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Portugal motorway pile-up.

text.p: Three people burned to death and eight others were injured in an eight-car motorway pile-up in northern Portugal on Friday.
A police spokesman said the victims were a 52-year-old woman and her son and daughter, both in their twenties.
He said the injured had been taken to hospital in Vila Nova de Gaia near the northern city of Oporto. Three were in a serious condition.
The accident occurred on a stretch of motorway just south of Oporto after a bus hit a car in heavy fog, causing a pile-up in which two cars burst into flames.
